title: Joint Learning of Hierarchical Neural Options and Abstract World Model
abstract: arXiv:2602.02799v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Building agents that can perform new skills by composing existing skills is a long-standing goal of AI agent research. Towards this end, we investigate how to efficiently acquire a sequence of skills, formalized as hierarchical neural options. However, existing model-free hierarchical reinforcement algorithms need a lot of data. We propose a novel method, which we call AgentOWL (Option and World model Learning Agent), that jointly learns -- in a sample efficient way -- an abstract world model (abstracting across both states and time) and a set of hierarchical neural options. We show, on a subset of Object-Centric Atari games, that our method can learn more skills using less data than baseline methods and possesses learning and generalization capabilities that the baselines do not have.

translated_title: 分层神经选项与抽象世界模型的联合学习
translated_abstract: 构建能够通过组合现有技能来执行新技能的智能体，是AI智能体研究的长期目标。为此，我们研究了如何高效地获取一系列技能，并将其形式化为分层神经选项。然而，现有的无模型分层强化学习算法需要大量数据。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，称为AgentOWL（选项与世界模型学习智能体），它以样本高效的方式联合学习一个抽象世界模型（在状态和时间两个维度上进行抽象）和一组分层神经选项。我们在以对象为中心的Atari游戏的一个子集上表明，与基线方法相比，我们的方法能够使用更少的数据学习更多技能，并具备基线方法所不具备的学习和泛化能力。
tldr: 提出AgentOWL方法，通过样本高效地联合学习抽象世界模型与分层神经选项，使智能体能够用更少的数据学习更多技能，并实现现有基线方法不具备的学习与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: AgentOWL jointly and sample-efficiently learns an abstract world model and hierarchical neural options, enabling agents to learn more skills with less data and achieve learning and generalization capabilities beyond existing baselines.
